resource "google_service_account" "scheduler" {
  account_id   = "cloud-scheduler-sa"
  display_name = "Cloud Scheduler Service Account"
  project      = var.project_id
}

locals {
  scheduler_sa = module.foundation.workload_sa_email != "" ? var.scheduler_sa_email : google_service_account.scheduler.email
  internal_processor_sa = var.internal_processor_sa_email != "" ? var.internal_processor_sa_email : "internal-processor-sa@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  public_gateway_sa = module.foundation.workload_sa_email != "" ? var.public_gateway_sa_email : "public-gateway-sa@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  public_gateway_url    = var.public_gateway_url != "" ? var.public_gateway_url : "https://public-gateway-${var.project_id}.run.app"
}

# Secret Manager Secret for order signing with automatic replication
resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "order_signing_secret" {
  secret_id = "order_signing_secret"
  project   = var.project_id

  # Replication: automatic
  replication {
    auto {}
  }

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "order-processing"
  }
}

# Initial Secret Version for order signing secret
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "order_signing_secret_version" {
  secret      = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.id
  secret_data = var.order_signing_secret_data
}

# Secret Manager IAM Member: Internal processor secretAccessor
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member" "internal_processor_secret_accessor" {
  project   = var.project_id
  secret_id = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.secret_id
  role      = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member    = "serviceAccount:${local.internal_processor_sa}"
}

# Project IAM Member: Internal processor secretAccessor
resource "google_project_iam_member" "internal_processor_secret_accessor" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${local.internal_processor_sa}"
}

# Project IAM Member: Internal processor datastore.user for Firestore
resource "google_project_iam_member" "internal_processor_datastore_user" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/datastore.user"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${local.internal_processor_sa}"
}

# Service Account IAM Invoker Binding: Cloud Scheduler invoking Public Gateway
resource "google_project_iam_member" "scheduler_run_invoker" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/run.invoker"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${local.scheduler_sa}"
}

# Service Account IAM Invoker Binding: Public Gateway invoking Internal Processor
resource "google_project_iam_member" "gateway_run_invoker" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/run.invoker"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${local.public_gateway_sa}"
}

# Cloud Scheduler daily reconciliation cron job targeting public-gateway
resource "google_cloud_scheduler_job" "daily_reconciliation" {
  name             = "daily-reconciliation"
  description      = "Daily reconciliation job targeting public-gateway /api/v1/reconcile"
  schedule         = "0 2 * * *"
  time_zone        = "UTC"
  project          = var.project_id
  region           = var.region
  attempt_deadline = "320s"

  http_target {
    http_method = "POST"
    uri         = "${trimsuffix(local.public_gateway_url, "/")}/api/v1/reconcile"

    oidc_token {
      service_account_email = local.scheduler_sa
      audience              = local.public_gateway_url
    }

    headers = {
      "Content-Type" = "application/json"
    }

    body = base64encode(jsonencode({
      trigger = "cloud-scheduler-daily-reconciliation"
    }))
  }
}

# stackvend: from infra/workload/variables.tf (IAC_ENGINEER)


variable "environment" {
  type        = string
  description = "Deployment environment name"
  default     = "prod"
}

variable "internal_processor_sa_email" {
  type        = string
  description = "Service account email for internal-processor Cloud Run service"
  default     = ""
}

variable "public_gateway_sa_email" {
  type        = string
  description = "Service account email for public-gateway Cloud Run service"
  default     = ""
}

variable "public_gateway_url" {
  type        = string
  description = "Target base URL for public-gateway service"
  default     = ""
}

variable "scheduler_sa_email" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing service account email for Cloud Scheduler job if pre-provisioned"
  default     = ""
}

variable "order_signing_secret_data" {
  type        = string
  description = "Initial secret payload for order_signing_secret"
  default     = "castor-default-order-signing-secret-key-32chars"
  sensitive   = true
}

# stackvend: from infra/workload/outputs.tf (IAC_ENGINEER)
output "order_signing_secret_id" {
  description = "Secret Manager secret ID for order signing secret"
  value       = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.secret_id
}

output "order_signing_secret_name" {
  description = "Full canonical resource name of the order signing secret"
  value       = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.name
}

output "order_signing_secret_version" {
  description = "Resource name of the initial order signing secret version"
  value       = google_secret_manager_secret_version.order_signing_secret_version.name
}

output "cloud_scheduler_job_id" {
  description = "Identifier of the daily reconciliation Cloud Scheduler job"
  value       = google_cloud_scheduler_job.daily_reconciliation.id
}

output "cloud_scheduler_job_name" {
  description = "Name of the daily reconciliation Cloud Scheduler job"
  value       = google_cloud_scheduler_job.daily_reconciliation.name
}

output "scheduler_service_account_email" {
  description = "Service account email utilized by Cloud Scheduler"
  value       = local.scheduler_sa
}

module "compute_internal_processor" {
  source                = "../modules/compute-cloudrun"
  project_id            = var.project_id
  region                = var.region
  product_id            = var.product_id
  service_name          = "internal-processor"
  service_account_email = module.foundation.workload_sa_email
  container_image       = replace(var.container_image, "/app:", "/internal-processor:")
  oauth_client_id       = var.oauth_client_id
  firebase_api_key      = var.firebase_api_key
  firebase_auth_domain  = var.firebase_auth_domain
  min_instances         = 0
  max_instances         = 2
  cpu_idle              = true
  allow_unauthenticated = var.allow_unauthenticated
  enable_direct_iap     = var.enable_direct_iap
  authorized_invoker_members = var.authorized_invoker_members
  cpu_limit             = var.cpu_limit
  memory_limit          = var.memory_limit
  env_vars              = merge(var.env_vars, {
    "FIRESTORE_DATABASE_NAME" = module.foundation.database_name
    "GCP_PROJECT_ID" = var.project_id
    "ORDER_SIGNING_SECRET_ID" = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.secret_id
    "PROJECT_ID" = var.project_id
    "SECRET_ORDER_SIGNING_SECRET" = google_secret_manager_secret.order_signing_secret.secret_id
  })

  depends_on = [module.foundation]
}
